public_definitions: The goal is to review the state prevalence dashboard and then open the state statistics view that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.

The comparison scope is the three options: Open New Hampshire (NH) statistics view for priority follow-up, Open Florida (FL) statistics view for priority follow-up, and Open Delaware (DE) statistics view for priority follow-up.
The rules are to use the state prevalence dashboard as the evidence source for the state priority view routing decision.
